# Allowlist for scripts/deps-gate.mjs. Changing this file needs CODEOWNERS review.
# dep <name>    direct dependency allowed in any package.json
# build <name>  package allowed to have an install/postinstall script or gypfile
# Transitive dependencies are covered by the frozen lockfile, `pnpm audit` and
# `pnpm install --ignore-scripts`; the gate fails on any install script outside `build`.
